name: Upper Mustang Trek
sub_region: Mustang District, Gandaki Province (Lo-Manthang, Lo-Ghekar Damodarkunda and Baragung Muktichhetra rural municipalities; Annapurna Conservation Area, restricted area)

difficulty.notes: Non-technical but long, dry, wind-exposed days on high plateau, with passes around 3,600-4,010 m (Nyi La 4,010 m highest on the main route; Marang La ~4,280 m on the eastern return). Strong afternoon winds. [s7][s8][s9]

duration_days.notes: Common loop: north on the western route (Chele, Syangboche, Ghami, Tsarang), south on the eastern route via Ghar Gompa, Dhakmar and Ghiling. Shorter versions retrace the same route or use jeeps. Since the Nov 2025 fee change the restricted-area fee is per day spent inside the zone, so trip length directly drives permit cost. [s5][s7][s8]

max_altitude_point: Nyi La pass (main route); Lo Manthang overnight ~3,840 m

itinerary.notes: Agency applies for restricted area permit. [s4]

itinerary.route: Kathmandu - Pokhara (flight ~25 min or drive 6-7 h)

itinerary.notes: Restricted zone starts just north of Kagbeni. [s8][s9]

itinerary.route: Acclimatisation day at Chele: hike above the village toward Taklam La and return
itinerary.notes: Climb high, sleep low before the long climb to Syangboche.

itinerary.route: Chele - Taklam La (3,624 m) - Samar - Syangboche

itinerary.notes: Tsarang listed 3,560-3,570 m; monastery and old fortress. [s8][s9]

itinerary.route: Tsarang - Lo La (3,950 m) - Lo Manthang
Explore Lo Manthang (Jampa Lhakhang, Thubchen, Chode, Royal Palace); optional Chhoser caves

itinerary.notes: Morning flight only; buffer day recommended. [s10][s11]

best_seasons.notes: Pokhara-Jomsom scheduled flights normally operate August-November. [s12] Upper Mustang is in the Himalayan rain shadow, so monsoon trekking is commonly marketed (UNVERIFIED).

permits.name: Upper Mustang Restricted Area Permit (Department of Immigration)
permits.fee: USD 50 per person per day spent in the restricted area (replaced the former USD 500 for first 10 days + USD 50/day beyond)
permits.valid_from: Cabinet decision of 18 Nov 2025 amending Schedule 12 of Immigration Regulation 1994

permits.name: Annapurna Conservation Area Permit (ACAP)
permits.fee: NPR 3,000 per foreign national (SAARC NPR 1,000), tax included

guide_requirements: Restricted area: permit must be applied for through a government-registered trekking agency and a licensed guide must accompany trekkers. Since 22 March 2026 (DoI notice) solo foreign trekkers can obtain the permit (previously minimum two); one guide may lead at most seven trekkers; the agency is responsible for rescue. [s4][s13][s14]

flights: Pokhara - Jomsom ~20-25 min, Twin Otter (Tara Air, Summit Air), early morning only; scheduled service suspended in mid/late October 2026, charters continuing [s10][s11][s12]
drives: Pokhara - Beni - Jomsom by jeep 7-9 h (Beni-Mustang road blocked by floods in early October 2026) [s9][s10]
logistics.notes: Lodges/teahouses in villages along the route. Monastery combined ticket in Lo Manthang reported at NPR 1,000 (UNVERIFIED). [s8]

highlights: Walled city of Lo Manthang, former capital of the Kingdom of Lo [s7][s8]
Thubchen, Jampa and Chode monasteries and the Royal Palace [s8]
Eroded red and ochre cliffs of Dhakmar and the Kali Gandaki badlands [s7]
risks: Jomsom flight cancellations; Oct 2026 suspension of scheduled flights [s10][s12]
Flood/landslide closure of the Beni-Jomsom road (Oct 2026) [s10]
Altitude above 3,500 m for several nights [s7]

acclimatization.notes: Rest/exploration day in Lo Manthang; Chele-Syangboche is a +750 m sleeping gain. [s7][s8]

unverified: The Department of Immigration's own fee pages (services page and trekking-route page, last updated Jan 2025) still show USD 500 for the first 10 days; NTB's permit page, Kathmandu Post, Rising Nepal and New Business Age report the USD 50/day fee. Confirm with DoI at booking.
Monsoon (Jun-Aug) suitability due to rain shadow is widely marketed but not tied to an authoritative source here.
Lo Manthang monastery combined ticket NPR 1,000 (single operator source).
Lo Manthang altitude 3,810-3,840 m depending on source.
